corners: mean of all corners = (1 - k/2) phi ; far corner = (1 - k) phi ; diagonal depth t reads (1 - t k) phi

cf3.centre: half the linear part + (1 - nu/2) kappa r^nu, no epsilon
cf3.far_corner: (1 - nu) kappa r^nu - eps s^2/2, no T_0, P_0
cf3.window_1_lt_nu_lt_2: formation part positive at the centre, negative at the far corner

tower: lambda and place enter only through lambda s^(k-2)

ends.lambda m -> infinity: rho -> 2 rho/(1 + rho^2), no lambda left

layer_at_rest: n = k ; none when k is not a whole number
